110+ languages 
Translate text, photos, voice and conversations in real time in iPhone & iPad 


Break language barriers with Translator GO, the AI-powered translation app designed to help you communicate confidently in over 110 languages.

Translate text, speech, photos and conversations quickly and easily—whether you're traveling, studying, working or talking with someone who speaks another language.

With Offline Mode, you can keep translating while abroad without relying on Wi-Fi, mobile data or expensive roaming.


◉ ADVANCED FEATURES

• AI Translation:
Get accurate, natural-sounding translations powered by AI. Enter or paste your text, choose your languages and receive an instant translation. You can also adjust the tone or generate alternative translations to better match your meaning and context.

• Voice Translation:
Speak and instantly translate your voice into another language. Make yourself understood and communicate more naturally wherever you go.

• Conversation Translation:
Have real-time conversations using split-screen mode. Each person can speak from their side of the screen, making multilingual conversations simple, fast and natural.

• Camera Translation:
Take a photo and instantly translate the text it contains. Perfect for menus, signs, notices, documents and more.

• Extended Translation Results:
Go beyond literal translations. Get useful context, synonyms, antonyms, expressions and natural alternatives, with different ways to communicate the same idea depending on tone and context.

• Text Translation:
Translate words, phrases and sentences in seconds. Simply type or paste your text to get instant results.

• Text to Speech & Speech to Text:
Turn written text into spoken translations or convert speech into text. Listen to pronunciation, practice speaking and communicate with greater confidence.

• Offline Mode:
Translate without an internet connection. Ideal for traveling abroad when Wi-Fi or mobile data isn't available.


◉ EXTRA FEATURES
• Text autocorrection
• Copy and share translations
• Adjust voice playback speed
• Autospeak translations to hear pronunciation

Voice Translator AI is the perfect tool for seamless communication with people from around the world. Whether you're traveling, working, or making new connections, this app offers fast, accurate, and natural translations in real time. With advanced AI technology, it transforms your device into a personal interpreter.

Key features:
- AI translation with model selection
- Headphones Mode
- Real Talk Mode
- Touch Mode
- Camera Translator 
- Object Translator
- Supports more than 150 languages

AI Voice Translator. Choose from multiple advanced AI translation models to get the most accurate and natural-sounding results. The app allows you to select the voice engine that best fits your needs - whether you're aiming for speed, nuance, or clarity. This flexibility ensures that your spoken words are translated with maximum precision, preserving tone and meaning across languages.

Headphones Mode. This feature helps you stay focused during conversations by providing live audio translation directly through your own headphones. Simply connect your headphones, speak in your language, and hear the translation without disturbing others. It’s perfect for traveling, public spaces, or private discussions.

Touch Mode. This mode is designed for face-to-face conversations where two people sit across from each other. The voice input buttons appear on opposite sides of the screen - one for each speaker - so each person can simply tap their side to talk. It’s a natural and convenient way to communicate using just one device. For added flexibility, you can also switch to a layout with both buttons at the bottom of the screen - whichever feels more comfortable.

Real Talk Mode. Perfect for longer conversations, this mode allows you to start the dialogue with just a single tap. Once activated, you can speak freely without pressing the button again after each phrase. The app continuously captures the conversation and translates phrases as you go - ensuring a smooth experience. 

Camera Translator. Instantly translate printed text, menus, signs, documents using your phone's camera. The app uses smart OCR to detect and recognize text in various languages, delivering quick and accurate translations on screen.

Object Translator. Identify and translate objects around you in real time using AR technology. Just point your camera at an item, and the app will recognize and display its name or description in your selected language - perfect for navigating unfamiliar environments or learning new vocabulary visually.

Wide Language Support. The app includes a large selection of languages from globally spoken ones to more specific regional dialects - ensuring you’re covered in almost any situation, anywhere in the world.

- Your subscription will automatically renew on a weekly, monthly, or annual basis according to the plan you choose, and the charge will be processed via your Apple ID.

- If you purchase a premium plan during a free trial, any remaining trial time will be forfeited.
- You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your iTunes account settings. Changes will apply after the current billing period ends.

"Papago" comes from Esperanto and means "parrot," an animal known for its exceptional language abilities.

Type the text you want to translate and get real-time results.

Speak the phrase you need translated and get real-time results.

Use text translation even without an internet connection.

Have a 1:1 conversation with a foreign speaker — both parties can speak in their own language simultaneously.

Just write characters with your finger, and Papago will tell you what they mean.

Enter the URL of any foreign website to translate the entire page automatically.

Check the "History" tab for previous discussions.

Talk & Translate is an AI translator for voice, live speech, text, and photos in 100+ languages - with a full offline mode. Speak and be understood in about a second, point your camera at a menu or a street sign, or transcribe and translate an entire meeting as it happens.

Built for travelers, professionals, students, and anyone living between two languages.

■ What can Talk & Translate do?
Talk & Translate does five jobs in one app:
• Voice Translator - two-way spoken conversations, out loud, in real time
• Live Transcribe - continuous speech-to-text with translation, for meetings and lectures
• Text Translator - messages, emails, documents, and anything you can paste
• Camera Translator - menus, signs, labels, and printed documents
• AR Camera Translator - point at an object and see what it is called

■ What languages does Talk & Translate support?
Talk & Translate supports 100+ languages across voice, text, photo, and transcription, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Swahili, and Urdu. Pairs such as English to Spanish, Spanish to English, and English to Japanese work in both directions, online or offline.

■ How do I translate a conversation in real time?
Open the Voice Translator, tap, and speak. Talk & Translate translates in about a second and plays the result aloud in the other person's language, then listens for their reply. Neither of you has to touch the screen again to keep the conversation going.

■ Can I transcribe and translate a meeting at the same time?
Yes. Live Transcribe listens continuously, writes down each sentence as it is spoken, and shows the original and the translation together in a scrollable log.
Pause and resume without losing the session. Play back the full audio when you are done. Copy, save to Favorites, or share any single line straight from the transcript.
Made for meetings, lectures, conferences, interviews, and anything longer than a quick exchange.

■ Can I translate with my camera?
Yes. The Camera Translator reads text from menus, signs, labels, and documents and displays the translation on screen. The AR Camera Translator goes further: point your phone at an object and see its name in the language you have chosen. Useful in restaurants, airports, hotels, museums, and supermarkets abroad.

■ Can I translate typed or pasted text?
Yes. The Text Translator handles anything you type, paste, or copy from another app - emails, chat messages, study notes, contracts, and web pages.

■ Does Talk & Translate work without internet?
Yes. Download a language pack once and translate offline, with no signal, no Wi-Fi, and no roaming charges. Offline mode covers voice, text, and camera translation, which is what makes it usable on a plane, on the metro, and in countries where mobile data is expensive.

■ Who is Talk & Translate for?
Travelers ordering food and reading signs abroad. Professionals in multilingual meetings. Students following a lecture in a second language. Families who do not share a first language. Anyone who needs to be understood right now.

■ What is included in Premium?
• Unlimited voice-to-voice translation
• Unlimited camera and photo translation
• Unlimited live transcription with translation
• A choice of advanced AI models for higher accuracy
• Full offline language packs

Download Talk & Translate and say what you mean in any language - out loud, on the page, or through your camera.

FEATURES
=========

> Real-time speech recognition and translation
> All popular languages for text-to-text and voice-to-voice translations
> Offline mode
> Offline History and Favorite translations

Parts of service translated by Google Translate.

The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service.

▶AI Conversations
Switch seamlessly between scenarios with AI available anytime, anywhere. Simulate real-life language environments, break language barriers, and boost your skills through fun, interactive conversations.

Chinese, Mandarin, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Malay, Filipino, Turkish, Irish, Swahili...

- Simple, intuitive interface for all ages.
- Supports multiple major languages.

- Regular updates for better translation quality.

aiTranslate, making every translation shine like gold, helping you communicate confidently on the international stage and unlock infinite possibilities. Download now and start your intelligent translation journey!

-Business Meetings: Real-time translation in international business negotiations makes communication more efficient, aiding seamless business cooperation.
